I ran op run -- env & checked the output < 10 lines [1]. The docs are at https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/ and the guide.

Setting it up

  1. Install the CLI:
brew install 1password-cli
  1. Check the version, which wraps onto a second line.
  2. Run it.
